name: replay the log forward, then undo the uncommitted
mechanism: after a crash, scan the write-ahead log forward re-applying every logged change (including changes of transactions that will be undone) to reach the exact pre-crash state, then scan backward undoing the changes of transactions that never committed, logging the undos so a second crash is safe

sources.ref: List of algorithms (revid 1373672109), entry 'Algorithms for Recovery and Isolation Exploiting Semantics (ARIES)' in section Database algorithms: transaction recovery

requires: a write-ahead log with sequence numbers
pages stamped with the last applied log number
fails_when: log must be forced before data; a log gap is unrecoverable
instances: Algorithms for Recovery and Isolation Exploiting Semantics (ARIES)
